resources.string: Keep the entire library, lyrics, artwork, vectors and server-prepared mixes on this phone. Original audio quality. Automatic sync over the local Wi-Fi or Ethernet network, including on battery.
Server rejected %1$d changes. Your action log is retained.
Sign in to the server again to resume synchronization. Your offline library is still available.
Synchronize pending actions before changing the folder or account.

Music and lyrics are ordinary files in a separate Caimack subfolder. Server deletions also remove synchronized copies. Turning sync off keeps the files. Offline radio contains up to 100 tracks and stops when the queue ends.
